summary: WF Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, announcing the appointment of Leah Siang Ling as Co-Chief Executive Officer and Board member, effective May 20, 2026. The appointment is a routine management change, not forced or abrupt, as Ling will serve alongside existing Co-CEO Chee Hoong Lew. No terms such as compensation, equity awards, or severance are disclosed in the filing. This is a foreign private issuer report equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02. There is no special situation event; the filing simply updates shareholders on a new executive appointment and attached employment and indemnification agreements.
